steps.text: Onion (40/50 g) and pepper (60/80 g) into a wide pan with the rapeseed oil (6/8 g), 4 minutes.
Tomato (80/100 g) and scotch bonnet in, 3 minutes, pressing it down.
500 ml stock, 2 tsp pepper soup spice, a bay leaf. Bring to a BARE simmer — never a boil.
Okra (100/120 g) topped and halved, in for 5 minutes.
Fish (100/130 g) in whole pieces, laid on top. Lid on, 8 minutes. Do not stir it.
Prawns (40/55 g) in for the last 3 minutes.
Spinach (120/150 g) folded through for the last 1.
Plantain (140/185 g) sliced thick, dry-griddled 3 minutes a side. Set aside.
Lime at the table. Plantain on the side.

why: A bare simmer and no stirring. Catfish and tilapia are soft, and a rolling boil shreds them into the broth — you want whole pieces you can lift out with a spoon.
notes: D0-003: the pan-softening oil (single hot-pan use for onion/pepper) becomes rapeseed_oil.

Griddle track (plantain) runs in parallel with the soup pan from clock 0, finishing at 0:06 and sitting ready well before the pot's 0:20 finish — the original 20 min time chip only holds if the two happen side by side, not back to back.
